result.summary: Independently re-verified TEST-DESIGNER's Step 3 coverage-verification pass; all claims held up under direct re-derivation, not just re-reading the self-report. (1) AC-to-test mapping: read docs/requirements.yaml's real REQ-208 entry (lines 11782-11847, 6 ACs) and cross-checked each against the actual test file's assertions rather than trusting test/specs/REQ-208.md's table. AC1/AC2's fuller end-to-end claims (committee route, quorum, disbursement, EO-002 full-run negative assertion) are honestly reported as unreachable due to a genuine, already-filed platform defect (Letflow.Engine.build_instance_state/3 hardcodes join_counters: %{} on every call, so a PARALLEL_GATEWAY join cannot fire across separate HTTP calls) -- confirmed the test itself (lines 557-703) asserts the real, reproducible HTTP 500 (step2b.outcome == :error, real 500 body) and real post-failure state integrity (credit-memo-review still PENDING, instance still ACTIVE at the same 2 nodes), not a stub or inferred result. AC3's :blocked/blocked_by/severity/captured are each individually asserted (lines 784-789) against a real Runner.run/1 return value, cross-checked against the scenario YAML's own blocked_by: 'ISS-0389' and runner.ex's :blocked dispatch clause. AC4/AC5 are report-content claims (test/reports/req208-meridian-scenario-findings.yaml), consistent with REQ-205/206/207's own precedent for this AC class. AC6 independently re-run (see below). (2) :no_task_of_type non-vacuousness: independently reproduced the mutation myself, not trusting TEST-DESIGNER's report -- edited test/support/simulation/runner.ex's :no_task_of_type clause (lines 598-617) to force outcome: :pass unconditionally, re-ran mix test test/letflow/simulation/req208_meridian_test.exs, got Result: 2/3 passed with the BaFin test failing exactly at EO-NO-TASK-002 ('expected :no_task_of_type(evidence-collection) to FAIL ... observed: [{"risk-evaluation", :pending}, {"evidence-collection", :completed}]') -- real, non-fabricated observed evidence, matching the self-report's claim exactly. Reverted via git checkout -- test/support/simulation/runner.ex; confirmed git status --porcelain test/support/simulation/runner.ex is empty; re-ran and confirmed Result: 3 passed. (3) :blocked/blocked_by/HTTP-500: confirmed real and individually-asserted, quoted above -- not present-but-unused fields. (4) Fixture isolation: setup block (line 333, not setup_all) generates a fresh unique tenant slug per test via Letflow.TenantSlugFixture.unique_slug('req208'); per-test tokens via Identity.create_token/3; on_exit teardown drops the tenant schema/rows per test. Grepped the test file for DateTime.utc_now, :rand., System.os_time, setup_all, password, secret, postgres:// -- zero matches. (5) Additivity: ran mix test test/letflow/simulation/ myself -- Result: 28 passed, no failures (REQ-205/206/207/208 combined). Also ran mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force (exit 0, clean, 180 files) and mix format --check-formatted (exit 0, clean). No gaps found; TEST-DESIGNER's self-report is accurate and independently corroborated.
